title: BEGIN_SPONSORING_FUTURE_RESERVES fails with BEGIN_SPONSORING_FUTURE_RESERVES_RECURSIVE
pattern: A transaction whose BEGIN_SPONSORING_FUTURE_RESERVES operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (recursive). One account begins sponsoring a second, which then tries to sponsor the first.

hazards.placement: two accounts trying to sponsor each other

facts.says: Operation 0 reports success in the failed transaction.
No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
